recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No follow-up is needed for current FHIR source unless a future maintenance branch restores Immunization.education.documentType from older source, in which case it should retain the already-correct "to the patient" wording.
issue_request: FHIR-14367 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core-Immunization asking to change the Immunization.education.documentType definition from "Identifier of the material presented ot the patient" to "Identifier of the material presented to the patient."
initial_application: The typo was introduced when Immunization.education.documentType was added for the Jan 2018 ballot and was corrected by the February 2018 ballot-response commit f451f3fc4b, which changed the relevant Immunization spreadsheet/XML text from "presented ot" to "presented to" before Jira later marked the issue Published.
additional_context: Immunization is still active in source/fhir.ini, but Immunization.education is now listed as removed and no longer appears in source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml. Later Published issue FHIR-32396 intentionally removed the education backbone in R5 and replaced it with narrative guidance to use Communication for educational-material conveyance; Public Health WG Confluence minutes confirm that decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The requested typo is absent from current source, and the element that contained it has been intentionally removed, so a source edit would be obsolete rather than corrective.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 decision that removed Immunization.education and made the old documentType definition obsolete in the current build.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction asking to fix "presented ot the patient" in Immunization.education.documentType.

evidence_items.summary: Immunization is an active resource, Immunization.education is listed as removed, and the current StructureDefinition contains no education/documentType element.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification R5 issue deciding to remove Immunization.education and document Communication as the conveyance mechanism for educational material.

evidence_items.learned: The active source already reflects the later decision and does not need a typo fix.

evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence confirms the source removal was intentional and approved.
